title.zh: 【MetaMask：正在应对影响部分基础设施的安全事件】
title.en: 【MetaMask：正在应对影响部分基础设施的安全事件】

current_state.zh: MetaMask says it is responding to a security incident affecting parts of its infrastructure and is proactively exiting affected validators from Lido as a precaution, with exits expected to complete by October 7, 2026 and the full exit-withdrawal-rejoin cycle taking roughly 45 days.
current_state.en: MetaMask says it is responding to a security incident affecting parts of its infrastructure and is proactively exiting affected validators from Lido as a precaution, with exits expected to complete by October 7, 2026 and the full exit-withdrawal-rejoin cycle taking roughly 45 days.
